verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a startup back-office platform covering incorporation, registered agent, compliance, accounting, tax, banking and mailroom, so a contract-workflow capability is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions contract drafting, negotiation, redlining or a controlled contract workflow. Its bookkeeper messaging and mailroom features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can draft, negotiate, and redline contracts in a controlled workflow instead of email attachments
